question:
Fill in the blank with the correct idiom selecting from the given alternatives.

solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. fly on the wall.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The idiom "Fly on the wall" means hidden observer.

◦ (छिपा हुआ दर्शक)

• The completed sentence reads: I wish I could be a fly on the wall during their private meeting to know what was really discussed.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. fly on the wall.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: kick the bucket (मर जाना): This idiom means die, which does not fit the context of the given sentence.

• Option 3: fall on deaf ears (अनसुना कर देना): This idiom means be ignored, which does not fit the context of the given sentence.

• Option 4: donkey’s years (बहुत लंबा समय): This idiom means a very long time, which does not fit the context of the given sentence.

5. Hang in the balance – Uncertain (अनिश्चित)
